sentences.text: Prevotella is a genus of anaerobic bacteria containing more than fifty characterised species, most of which live in association with humans rather than in other habitats.
A comparative genome study proposed reclassifying species previously assigned to the genus Prevotella into seven genera, so some of them carry different genus names in newer papers.
In people the genus is abundant at many body sites, including the mouth and other mucosal surfaces, where its members influence the balance between health and disease.
Gut Prevotella are correlated with plant-rich diets high in carbohydrate and fibre, and diet, lifestyle and geography strongly shape which species and strains a person carries.

Studies have associated higher Prevotella abundance at mucosal sites with periodontitis, bacterial vaginosis and rheumatoid arthritis, while lower abundance has been reported in asthma and COPD airways.
